reviewed_upstream.observation: No 3DM/Rhino reader or writer symbol is present. The module covers the formats QymCAD itself supports.
No 3DM/Rhino import-export entry point is exposed.
Native shape exchange is not a 3DM reader; no ONX_Model/ON_BinaryArchive call is present.

reviewed_upstream_opennurbs.observation: Read loop uses ONX_Model::Read and the model component iterator; the local bridge keeps the same read-only ownership boundary.
Archive version/chunk and unit-system surface used by the probe and the unit projection.

qa_finding: M00 L2-04 already proved QymCAD contains no 3DM reader; this L3 audit confirms it at the three candidate paths.
rationale: QymCAD has no 3DM reader/writer. The product bridge is new Rust ownership around the pinned openNURBS C++ static library and the language-local C ABI; no QymCAD code or naming is copied.
not_reused: QymCAD format registry: it does not contain Rhino 3DM.
FreeCAD legacy 3DM adapters: historical inputs, not the standalone OM9 runtime.
